title: Token Tower - OFFICIAL TRAILER - I wanted a fun agent monitoring tool so I made it
author: OnyxMonolith
selftext: the web app monitors projects/agents but also has Tiny Tower-ish progression with a dark twist through token spend :D[](https://www.reddit.com/r/IndieDev/?f=flair_name%3A%22Video%22)

comments.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
comments.body: Interesting. I love the concept. Does the novelty wear off or are you finding this useful?

replies.author: OnyxMonolith
replies.body:
I use it for all my projects to actually monitor them so it's really useful too. it alerts me when agents ask questions, when they are finished, when there is an error, etc. there are stats, spend.

all the projects in the game are real. (for the purpose of the trailer I made things up, obviously)

when i have a fun idea i will sometimes ask teh agent to design a new floor. it looks cool on a vertical monitor.
